items.title: Tech stocks today: Meta agrees to settle social media case for $16.68 billion; Nvidia tops Q2 expectations
Is Meta a buy after its $16.68 billion social media case settlement?
items.summary: The price of Meta (META) ticked up before paring gains after the company agreed it would pay $16.68 billion to settle a social media addiction case with a group of state attorneys general. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi talks with Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre, Sevens Report Research Founder Tom Essaye, and Edward Jones Senior Global Investment Strategist Angelo Kourkafas about the company's future and how it will approach monetizing AI.

items.title: Meta settles social media trial, agreeing to pay up to $16.7B: Reuters
items.summary: Meta (META) reached a settlement in its social media trial, according to Reuters. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley discusses the details with Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma and Payne Capital Management president Ryan Payne.

items.title: Meta settlement puts social media industry on notice: 'There will be more'
items.summary: Wednesday's historic settlement between Meta and dozens of US states could be just the start of a wave that will ripple across the social media industry, putting TikTok, YouTube and Snap under pressure to make similar changes to their apps for teens."I hope that Snapchat, TikTok and YouTube will read the writing on the wall and enter into similar settlements," Lopez said in a statement.
